name: 15-Minute Meal Basics
equipment: A skillet, a sheet pan, and 3-4 airtight containers
instructions: Pick one quick-cooking protein (eggs, canned beans, or pre-cooked chicken) and 2-3 vegetables that all roast or saute in under 15 minutes.
Prep everything in one pan or sheet at once instead of cooking components separately -- fewer dishes, less total time.
Season simply (salt, pepper, one dried herb, a squeeze of citrus) so the same base works across several different meals.
Portion into containers as soon as it cools slightly, so it is grab-and-go for the next few days.
